quarterly_data.quarter: Naver press release: NAVER Shopping App's AI Shopping Agent Gets DeliveryFocused (09-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: NAVER release (09-17-2026): the AI Shopping Agent in the NAVER Shopping app now factors in real-time delivery information (order cutoff times, actual arrival dates for the user's address) and narrows options when fast delivery is needed. Usage since the official launch: as of September, conversations with the agent were up about 60% from June and gross merchandise value (GMV) generated through the agent was up 82%
quarterly_data.figure: agent conversations up about 60% from June; agent GMV up 82% (as of September)
